newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was moderate in the panhandle area late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 7,100 slaughter steers and 1,300 heifers; 136,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 21,900 formulated and 4,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1100 lbs 63.00.
Week to date: 126,300 Week Ago: 85,600 Year Ago: 75,100
